figures.finding: Not researched today; producer-CN.json: the National Film Industry Development Special Fund rewards films (cinema box office), not television; no national production rebate found. Television drama support (NRTA) was not reached today. Filed and licensed counts don't cover the same projects (a series is licensed months or years after filing), so the ratio is not a pick-up rate. Over August to October 2026 about 44 TV series a month were filed; 32 TV series were licensed in July to September 2026, about 11 a month. No count of how many licensed series a broadcaster or platform then airs was found, nor any broadcaster's commissioning terms.

value.gate: every TV or web series is filed with NRTA before shooting (monthly public filing list) and needs a distribution licence (发行许可证) once made
